name: Navigator
description: The Navigator OS brand colour palette — a nautical & sky identity themed around the compass, lighthouse, Orion and the North Star.

teal.description: The primary accent colour — interactive elements, focus states, the assistant panel

purple.description: The secondary accent colour — pairs with teal in gradients, the AI/assistant context

gold.description: The North Star accent — notifications, warnings, brand details

navy.description: The navy base — the night-sky ground, window backgrounds, the panel ground

assistant.usage: The active window border, the assistant panel accent (see hyprland/hyprland.conf)

notes: This palette is a Phase 1 draft; GTK/Qt theme production will take shape under theme/gtk and theme/qt in Phase 2.
The colour values inside hyprland/hyprland.conf are kept in manual sync with this file.
